doctor: NAME_1, how long already the cough?
patient: Three days doctor, malam lagi teruk. Ada kahak kuning.
doctor: Any chest pain or breathless?
patient: No chest pain. Sikit-sikit breathless when climb stairs only.
doctor: Temperature 37.9, pulse 92, oxygen 97 percent. Throat red, chest clear. This is viral upper respiratory infection. Paracetamol 1 gram four times a day if fever. Review in one week, come earlier if breathless worsen or fever not settle. I order FBC if not improving.
output:
Title: Persistent cough with yellow mucus  
## Subjective  
- Cough for three days with worsening severity  
- Yellow productive cough  
- No chest pain or shortness of breath  
## Objective  
- Temperature 37.9° C  
- Pulse 92 bpm  
- Oxygen saturation 97%  
- Throat red, chest clear  
## Assessment  
- Viral upper respiratory infection  
## Plan  
- Paracetamol 1g every 4 hours for fevers  
- Monitor for progression of cough or breathing difficulty  
## Orders & follow-ups  
- Follow up in one week if not improved  
- Order full blood count (FBC) if not responding to treatment  
- Return early if breathlessness worsens or fever persists

Title: Diabetes management with knee pain  
## Subjective  
- Diabetic patient with morning glycosylated hemoglobin (GHB) levels of ~7  
- Knee pain worsening for two weeks, uses ibuprofen occasionally  
## Objective  
- Fasting glucose 6.8 mmol/L  
- Blood pressure 128/82 mmHg  
- Weight remains stable  
## Assessment  
- Controlled sugar metabolism with metformin 500mg bid  
- Gastritis history requiring caution with NSAIDs  
- Knee pain managed via topical diclofenac gel rather than oral ibuprofen  
## Plan  
- Maintain current metformin therapy  
- Monitor fasting glucose regularly  
- Topical diclofenac gel applied thrice daily for knee discomfort  
- Perform HbA1c test today  
- Refer to physical therapist for knee rehabilitation  
- Follow up in蟋蟀 months after testing results  

## Orders & follow-ups  
- Repeat fasting glucose every day until stabilized  
- HbA1c result available by tomorrow  
- Physiotherapy session scheduled within next week  
- Revisit in three months post-testing results
